items.text: Bored holes keep cable at least 1-1/4 in from the nearest stud edge, front and back.
Every hole or notch that breaks the 1-1/4 in setback is plated with steel at least 1/16 in thick before cable is pulled.
Kick plates are stocked on the truck and counted in the takeoff — never treated as an extra.

Underground runs buried to the Table 300.5 row for their method and location — UF 24 in, PVC 18 in, RMC 6 in, residential 120V 20A GFCI branch circuit 12 in — measured to the top of the cable or raceway.
At least 6 in of free conductor at every splice and outlet box; at least 3 in out of any opening smaller than 8 in.
Box fill figured and written on the rough-in sheet for every multi-cable or multi-device box before close-in.
NM sheath extends at least 1/4 in into every box, past the clamp.
Fan-rated box at every habitable-room ceiling outlet where a fan could go.
Every junction box stays accessible after finishes — no box behind drywall, tile or fixed cabinets.
NM stapled within 12 in of every box and at least every 4-1/2 ft, snug without crushing the sheath; never stapled on edge.
No NM in wet or damp locations, underground raceways, or as service cable — UF or raceway conductors used instead.
Attic runs within 6 ft of the scuttle: NM along the sides of joists/trusses only, parallel to framing, no diagonals, no guard strips, bends 1.5 ft clear of the opening.
Wire choice per S-10: copper by default; CCA one AWG size up, AL-CU/CU-AL connectors only, never backstabbed.
Microwave circuit stays 12 AWG copper on its own 20A circuit, even on a CCA job.
Receptacle boxes set 18 in to the BOTTOM of the box and switch boxes 48 in to center where the plan is silent; box faces flush with the finished surface. (S-04 receptacles / S-05 switches.)
EMT fastened within 3 ft of each box and supported every 10 ft; total bends between pull points counted and kept at or under 360 degrees.
Wet-location and concrete EMT fittings are compression / concrete-tight type, made up tight.
Long exposed PVC runs checked for expansion; expansion fitting installed where movement reaches 1/4 in.
Every penetration of a fire-rated wall, floor or ceiling is firestopped with a listed system matched to that assembly — generic foam is not a firestop.

Pull and junction boxes with conductors 4 AWG or larger are sized by 314.28 geometry (straight pull 8x the largest raceway; angle/U pull 6x plus the other raceways in the row), not by cubic-inch fill.
Grounds counted the 2020 way: up to four EGCs/bonding jumpers = one allowance at the largest; each one past four adds a quarter allowance.
